# Assumption of Moses Chapter 5 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal)
**Translator:** LOGOS | **Source:** Latin palimpsest (Codex Ambrosianus) | **Section:** The Coming Western King and Priestly Rule

---

**1** And there will come upon them a mighty king from the west who will conquer them and take possession of them.

**2** He will carry off their captives as plunder and will take some of them with him to his own land.

**3** He will burn part of their sanctuary with fire and will crucify some of them around their city.

**4** In those days a king will arise who will be insolent, showing no respect for anyone, a man who will govern them as they deserve.

**5** He will judge them as they judged, for they will have defiled the holy things of the Lord.

**6** For twenty years he will afflict them.

**7** Then will arise a man of the tribe of Levi who will fear the Lord and act with justice.

**8** His sons will rule after him for short years.

**9** After a short time the kingdom will be diminished, and troops of mixed and impure origin will trouble it.

**10** Then a powerful king will come from the west and will conquer them and lead them away with him.

**11** These commanders will become petty rulers with power over many lands.

**12** They will burn a temple with fire and will carry off gold from it.

**13** Those who live in the land will be in great distress for a long time.

**14** There will be a time appointed for the Lord to deal with them.
